question: Should maintainers require inspectable exact-head sessions_spawn MCP allow/deny output before accepting this child tool-authorization change?
rationale: The source and tests now look sound, but the contributor's claimed real run is narrative-only and the change crosses persisted child-session state and a security-sensitive tool boundary.

options.title: Require Exact-Head Proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until the conflict-resolved head has redacted terminal output or logs showing the allowed MCP tool executes and a denied tool is absent.

options.title: Override The Proof Gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the conflict-resolved source and tests without independently inspectable contributor runtime evidence.
